statement_record.book: A preorder is SKELETAL when x <= y and y <= x imply x = y (i.e. it is a poset); a quantale is SKELETAL when its underlying preorder is skeletal. Bool and Cost are skeletal quantales. Skeletality is exactly the hypothesis that makes profunctor composition strictly (not merely up to iso) unital and associative.
statement_record.intree: poset_nat_skeletal : forall x y : obj[Poset_nat], (x ~{Poset_nat}~> y) -> (y ~{Poset_nat}~> x) -> x = y; and Poset {C : Type} `{R : relation C} `(P : PreOrder C R) `{@Antisymmetric C eq eq_equiv R} : Category := Proset P.

(1) The skeletal-PREORDER half is present in substance: the in-tree Poset construction takes exactly the book's condition as its `Antisymmetric C eq R` hypothesis (which unfolds to `forall x y, R x y -> R y x -> x = y`), and poset_nat_skeletal / poset_two_skeletal state that condition at the category level (mutually related objects are literally equal).
